maritime.contentTitle: Financial Advisory and Consulting Specialized for the Maritime Sector
maritime.intro1: International shipping involves sector-specific dynamics in financial management, accounting, tax, and payroll processes. Sound financial management in ship operations and broking affects not only legal compliance but also sustainable growth and competitiveness.
maritime.intro2: Our office provides sector-specific financial advisory and consulting to ship operators, broking companies, and maritime businesses operating in international waters.
services: Financial advisory and general accounting services
Financial reporting in line with national and international standards
Management reports, budgeting, and cash flow planning
Foreign currency transactions and exchange rate accounting
Tax planning, declaration processes, and regulatory compliance
Payroll, social security, and HR processes for crew and office staff
Internal control, financial analysis, and management consulting
Independent audit and financial reporting support for financial institutions
maritime.approach: Our approach goes beyond fulfilling legal obligations. We work with a consulting mindset that strengthens financial performance, anticipates risks, and supports strategic decision-making.
maritime.experience: Thanks to our experience with numerous companies in the maritime sector, we offer reliable and sustainable solutions and aim to be a strong financial partner on your journey in the global market.
maritime.quote: Experience sets the course in maritime; financial confidence comes from the right financial advisory.

production.contentTitle: Financial Advisory and Consulting Specialized for the Manufacturing Sector
production.intro1: The manufacturing sector has a dynamic structure requiring high expertise in cost accounting, inventory management, raw material and finished goods tracking, export operations, financial planning, and tax applications. For manufacturing businesses, financial advisory is not only about fulfilling legal obligations but also a strategic management function that increases efficiency and competitiveness.
production.intro2: Our office provides sector-specific financial advisory and consulting to manufacturing companies operating in metal, pipe fittings, machinery, production, and industrial fields. We analyze the financial impact of production processes to help businesses make sound financial decisions and support sustainable growth.
services: General accounting and financial advisory services
Cost accounting and production cost analysis
Accounting for raw materials, semi-finished and finished goods inventory
Preparation of financial statements and management reporting
Budget, cash flow, and profitability analysis
Accounting and tax processes for export and import operations
VAT refund processes and incentive applications
Payroll, social security, and HR processes
Independent audit and financial reporting support for financial institutions
production.experience: With our experience serving many businesses in the manufacturing sector, we closely follow industry needs and work as a trusted solution partner with accurate reporting, effective cost management, and strong financial planning.
production.goal: Our goal is not only to ensure manufacturing businesses fulfill their legal obligations, but to build a long-term partnership that supports decision-making with accurate financial data, increases efficiency, and contributes to sustainable growth.
